name: Login to ECR via OIDC
description:
Configures AWS credentials via OIDC and logs into Amazon ECR.
Works uniformly on all runner types (AWS EC2, GCP, ROCm, b200, etc.)

aws-role-to-assume.description: IAM role to assume via OIDC

role-duration-seconds.description: Duration for the assumed role session

use-iam-profile-if-available.description: If true, will check for and use an IAM instance profile if available.
